sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanmesh"."zoneref" AS e, "sites"."riskeval" AS g, SUM("scanmesh"."facetfaces") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("scanmesh"."geomdeltamm" - "scanmesh"."facetresmm") AS REAL) / "scanmesh"."facetresmm")) AS m2 FROM "scanmesh" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanmesh"."zoneref"  GROUP BY "scanmesh"."zoneref", "sites"."riskeval"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s2"."m1" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: scanmesh.relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing
why: total of mesh faces per sites within sites.riskeval (additive)
(geometric deviation - mesh vertex spacing) / mesh vertex spacing: the relative difference of two quantities in mm
average of relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing per sites within sites.riskeval
coarsen to g: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
share of the all total of total of total of mesh faces (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanregistration"."arcref" AS e, "projects"."fundflux" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanregistration"."errvalmm" - "scanregistration"."logaccumm") AS REAL) / "scanregistration"."logaccumm")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "scanregistration" JOIN "projects" ON "projects"."arcregistry" = "scanregistration"."arcref"  GROUP BY "scanregistration"."arcref", "projects"."fundflux"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m2") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s2"."m2" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: scanregistration.relative difference of registration error from registration accuracy
why: (registration error - registration accuracy) / registration accuracy: the relative difference of two quantities in mm
average of relative difference of registration error from registration accuracy per projects within projects.fundflux
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of scanregistration records (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanprocessing"."zoneref" AS e, "sites"."typesite" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanprocessing"."remaingb" - "scanprocessing"."memusagegb") AS REAL) / "scanprocessing"."memusagegb")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "scanprocessing" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanprocessing"."zoneref"  GROUP BY "scanprocessing"."zoneref", "sites"."typesite"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m2") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s2"."m2" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: scanprocessing.relative difference of remaining storage space from RAM usage
why: (remaining storage space - RAM usage) / RAM usage: the relative difference of two quantities in GB
average of relative difference of remaining storage space from RAM usage per sites within sites.typesite
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of scanprocessing records (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanpointcloud"."arcref" AS e, "projects"."fundflux" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanpointcloud"."refpct" - "scanpointcloud"."lappct") AS REAL) / "scanpointcloud"."lappct")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "scanpointcloud" JOIN "projects" ON "projects"."arcregistry" = "scanpointcloud"."arcref"  GROUP BY "scanpointcloud"."arcref", "projects"."fundflux"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: scanpointcloud.relative difference of surface reflectivity from scan overlap
why: (surface reflectivity - scan overlap) / scan overlap: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of surface reflectivity from scan overlap per projects within projects.fundflux
share of the all total of number of scanpointcloud records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
